problems.title: Logarithms of powers
problems.question: Evaluate log₈₁27.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity, with domain conditions checked first.
steps: Write both numbers as powers of 3.

problems.title: Change logarithm base
problems.question: If $\log_2 3=a,\log_2 5=b$, find $\log_{12}80$.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity, with domain conditions checked first.
steps: The numerator is 4+b and the denominator is 2+a.

problems.title: Domain of a square root of logarithms
problems.question: Which listed number is outside the domain of $\sqrt{\log_9(6x+1)+\log_{199}(7x+1)}$?
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity, with domain conditions checked first.
formulas: Each logarithm needs a positive argument and their sum must be nonnegative.
steps: For x≥0 both logarithms are nonnegative. At x=−.1 both arguments are positive but less than 1, so both logarithms are negative.

problems.title: Prism volume from a normal section
problems.question: A triangular prism has lateral edge 6 and pairwise distances 3,4,5 between lateral edges. Find its volume.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity, with domain conditions checked first.
steps: A section perpendicular to the lateral edges is a 3–4–5 right triangle, with are a 3·4/2=6. Multiply by the edge length 6.

problems.title: Cone axial area equals base area
problems.question: A cone’s axial section has the same are a as its base. Find tan of the angle between a generator and the base.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity, with domain conditions checked first.
steps: Equality gives h=πr.

problems.title: Arithmetic progression of logarithms
problems.question: log₇3, log₇x, log₇y, log₇24 for m an arithmetic progression. Find x+y.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity, with domain conditions checked first.
formulas: Equal log differences mean $3, x, y,24$ for m a geometric progression.
steps: Its positive ratio satisfies r³=24/3=8, so r=2. Thus x=6, y=12.

problems.title: Reciprocal logarithms
problems.question: Solve $1/\log_2x+1/\log_3x+1/\log_4x=1$.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity, with domain conditions checked first.
steps: Combine the left side as logₓ(2·3·4)=logₓ24. Its value is 1 exactly when x=24.

problems.title: Lateral area of a square pyramid
problems.question: A regular square pyramid has base side 2 and lateral edge 3. Find its lateral are a.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity, with domain conditions checked first.
steps: Four triangular faces have total are a 4·(2·l/2).

problems.title: Three perpendicular cone generators
problems.question: A cone has three pairwise perpendicular generators. Find tan² of the generator’s angle to the base.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity, with domain conditions checked first.
formulas: The three unit generator directions for m an orthonormal basis. Each has the same axial component $\sin\theta$.
steps: The squared projections of the unit axis on this basis sum to 1, so 3sin²θ=1. Thus tan²θ=(1/3)/(2/3).

problems.title: A power with a logarithmic exponent
problems.question: Evaluate $(625^{\log_5 2024})^{0.25}$.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity, with domain conditions checked first.
steps: The outer fourth root cancels the factor 4 in the exponent.

problems.title: How many real solutions?
problems.question: Which has exactly two real roots? I: $\log_3x^2+\log_3x^3=1$; II: $\log_3x^2+\log_3x^4=1$; III: $9^x-3^{x+3}=1$.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity, with domain conditions checked first.
formulas: I requires $x>0$ and gives $x^5=3$. II requires $x\ne0$ and gives $x^6=3$.
steps: I has one positive root; II has the two roots ±3^(1/6). In III, t=3ˣ>0 gives t²−27t−1=0, whose root product is −1, so exactly one root is positive.

problems.title: Nested logarithms
problems.question: Natural x satisfies $\log_2(\log_{16}x)=\log_4(\log_4x)$. Find its digit sum.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity, with domain conditions checked first.
steps: This gives log₂t=2, hence t=4 and x=4⁴=256. Add its digits.

problems.title: Integer values in a range
problems.question: Find the sum of all integers in the range of log₃(15−12sin x).
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity, with domain conditions checked first.
steps: The logarithm is increasing, so the range is [1,3]. Its integers are 1,2,3.

problems.title: A quadratic in a logarithm
problems.question: Find the sum of roots of $(\log_2(4x))^2+\log_2(8x)=13$.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity, with domain conditions checked first.
steps: Factor t²+5t−6=(t+6)(t−1). The corresponding x values are 1/64 and 2.

problems.title: Height from all six edges
problems.question: In tetrahedron DABC, AB=5, AC=3, BC=4, AD=3, BD=4, CD=$12\sqrt2/5$. Find its height above ABC.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity, with domain conditions checked first.
steps: Subtract CD² from AD² to obtain −6u+9=9−288/25, giving u=48/25. Similarly −8v+16=16−288/25 gives v=36/25. Thus h²=288/25−(48²+36²)/625=144/25.

problems.title: Nested roots with integer indices
problems.question: For all x>1, $\sqrt[a]{x\sqrt[b]{x\sqrt[c]{x}}}=\sqrt[36]{x^{25}}$, with integers a, b, c>1. Find b.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity, with domain conditions checked first.
steps: The numerator is at most 7/4, so a cannot be at least 3; hence a=2. Then (1+1/c)/b=7/18. Since 1<1+1/c≤3/2, we get 18/7<b≤27/7, forcing b=3. It gives c=6.

problems.title: A graph point in quadrant IV
problems.question: Which printed function has a point with x>0, y<0?
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity, with domain conditions checked first.
steps: The exponential options are positive. For x>0, log₁₉₉(x+7) and log₃(x+4) are positive. log₀.₃(.4−x), where defined with x>0, is positive too. But log₀.₂(x+2) is negative for every x>0.

problems.title: An empty logarithmic equation
problems.question: Find a such that $\log_2x-\log_ax+\log_4x=1$ has no solution.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity, with domain conditions checked first.
steps: There is no solution precisely when the coefficient is zero. Thus log₂a=2/3 and a=2^(2/3).

problems.title: Cylinder radius from perpendicular chords
problems.question: Two vertical section planes of a cylinder meet along a generator at right angles. Their distances from the axis are 2.5 and 6. Height is 4. Find axial-section are a.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity, with domain conditions checked first.
formulas: In the base the two perpendicular chord lines meet at a circle point, so $r^2=2.5^2+6^2$.
steps: The radius is 6.5. The axial rectangle has width 13 and height 4.

problems.title: An oblique section through a cone apex
problems.question: A section plane through a cone apex makes 45° with the base and cuts off a quarter-circle arc. The height is 10. Find its section are a.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity, with domain conditions checked first.
formulas: The chord subtends 90°, so its distance from the centre is $r/\sqrt2$. The plane angle gives $10/(r/\sqrt2)=\tan45^\circ=1$.
steps: Thus r=10√2 and the chord has length r√2=20. The altitude of the triangular section is √(10²+10²)=10√2.

problems.title: Natural logarithmic quantities
problems.question: The four positive integers $\sqrt{\lg a},\sqrt{\lg b},\lg\sqrt a,\lg\sqrt b$ sum to 36. Find ab.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity, with domain conditions checked first.
steps: Because u²/2, v²/2 are integers, u, v are positive even integers. The only positive integer square decomposition of 74 is 25+49, giving u, v=4,6 in either order. Thus lg(ab)=16+36=52.

problems.title: Eight small spheres around a large sphere
problems.question: A square prism of base side 4 contains a radius-2 sphere and eight radius-1 spheres arranged at its corners as in the drawing. Find its height.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity, with domain conditions checked first.
formulas: A small centre is 1 from two side faces and one end face. The large centre is horizontally at the base centre. Their horizontal separation is $\sqrt2$, and their distance is $2+1=3$.
steps: Their vertical separation is √(9−2)=√7. The two layers of small centres are at heights 1 and H−1, with the large centre midway. Hence H−2=2√7.
problems.note: The text says each small sphere touches three lateral faces. That is impossible in a width-4 square prism for radius 1. The figure and answer use three prism faces at a corner: two lateral faces and an end face.

problems.title: Intercepts of a function and its inverse
problems.question: For f(x)=log₃(x+3), A, B are its axis intercepts and C, D are those of its inverse. Find quadrilateral ABCD are a.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity, with domain conditions checked first.
steps: The perpendicular diagonals AC and BD both have length 3. Their are a is half the product.

problems.title: Two logarithmic variables
problems.question: If $\log_2x=\log_y16$ and xy=64, find $(\log_2(x/y))^2$.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity, with domain conditions checked first.
steps: The target is (u−v)²=(u+v)²−4uv=36−16.

problems.title: Height from a projected section
problems.question: ABC is right-angled at C. Tetrahedron DABC has equal lateral edges. BM:MD=1:2. Planes AMC and ABC make 60°, are a AMC=4, and height times are a ABC=3. Find the height.
problems.idea: Use the relevant identity, with domain conditions checked first.
formulas: The projection O of D is the circumcentre, the midpoint of AB. Its distance from AC is half B’s distance.
steps: M=(2B+D)/3, so its projection has distance (2/3+1/6)=5/6 of B’s distance from AC. Thus projected are a AMC equals (5/6) are a ABC. Projection also gives 4cos60°=2. Hence are a ABC=12/5, and h=3/(12/5).
